I've confirmed it to Tobias in your DM: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team about the Thistle rollout is now Fridays at 8:30.

I didn't save it as a separate note. The brain already stores direct messages automatically, and only Tobias can see them, so his own message is the record. The brain's separate save tool didn't make clear who could see what it stores. Using it might have exposed his DM to other people.

As he asked, I didn't change his calendar, contact Marrow Fieldworks or post anything else.
